if.name: if

parameterDocs.name: condition
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression; the contents show when it is truthy.

elseif.name: elseif
elseif.description:
Used within `{if}` to provide an additional conditional branch.

Usage: `{elseif condition}`

parameterDocs.name: condition
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression; the branch shows when it is truthy and no earlier branch matched.

else.name: else
else.description:
Used within `{if}` to provide a fallback branch.

Usage: `{else}`

for.name: for
for.description: Loop block. Usage: `{for @item of $list}...{/for}` or `{for @item, @index of $list}...{/for}`

next.name: next
next.description:
Starts the next section of a `{timed}` block, shown after the given delay (immediately when omitted).

Usage: `{next delay}` or `{next}`

parameterDocs.name: delay
parameterDocs.documentation: Delay before the next section shows; omit for immediately.

stop.name: stop
stop.description:
Stops the enclosing `{repeat}` loop. It has no effect anywhere else, including in a `{for}` loop.

Usage: `{stop}`

switch.name: switch

parameterDocs.name: value
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression compared with each `{case}`.

case.name: case
case.description:
Defines a branch within a `{switch}` macro.

Usage: `{case value}`

parameterDocs.name: value
parameterDocs.documentation: Value (or values) this branch matches.

default.name: default
default.description:
Defines the default branch within a `{switch}` macro.

Usage: `{default}`

set.name: set
set.description:
Sets variables based on the given expression.

Usage: `{set $var to value}`

Supports `$var` (story), `_var` (temporary), `@var` (local), and `%var` (transient) variables.

parameterDocs.name: assignment
parameterDocs.documentation: Assignment such as `$var to value`; further comma-separated assignments may follow.

unset.name: unset
unset.description:
Unsets one or more variables.

Usage: `{unset $var}`

Supports `$var` (story), `_var` (temporary), `@var` (local), and `%var` (transient) variables.

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Variable to remove (`$var`, `_var`, `@var` or `%var`).

computed.name: computed
computed.description:
Evaluates an expression and outputs the result.

Usage: `{computed expression}`

parameterDocs.name: expression
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression whose result is output.

print.name: print
print.description:
Outputs the result of the given expression.

Usage: `{print expression}`

parameterDocs.name: expression
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression whose result is output.

do.name: do
do.description:
Displays its contents. Can be updated dynamically.

Usage:

```
{do}
  ...
{/do}
```

link.name: link
link.description:
Creates a link that executes its contents when clicked.

Usage:

```
{link "text" "passage"}
  ...
{/link}
```

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Text of the link.

parameterDocs.name: passage
parameterDocs.documentation: Passage to go to when clicked; omit to run the contents.

button.name: button
button.description:
Creates a button that executes its contents when clicked.

Usage:

```
{button "text" "passage"}
  ...
{/button}
```

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Text of the button.

parameterDocs.name: passage
parameterDocs.documentation: Passage to go to when clicked; omit to run the contents.

timed.name: timed

parameterDocs.name: delay
parameterDocs.documentation: Delay before the contents show; omit for immediately.

repeat.name: repeat
repeat.description:
Repeatedly displays its contents at the specified interval.

Usage:

```
{repeat delay}
  ...
{/repeat}
```

parameterDocs.name: interval
parameterDocs.documentation: Delay between repeats.

type.name: type
type.description:
Outputs its contents one character at a time, mimicking a typewriter effect.

Usage:

```
{type speed}
  ...
{/type}
```

parameterDocs.name: speed
parameterDocs.documentation: Typing speed.

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) that receives the chosen option.

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) that receives the current option.

option.name: option
option.description:
Defines an option within a `{listbox}` or `{cycle}` macro.

Usage: `{option label}`

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Text and value of the option.

parameterDocs.name: more
parameterDocs.documentation: Further words of an unquoted label.

parameterDocs.name: name
parameterDocs.documentation: Widget name, followed by its `@param` names.

meter.name: meter
meter.description:
Displays a progress meter.

Usage: `{meter $var min max}`

parameterDocs.name: current
parameterDocs.documentation: Current value expression; a maximum expression and an optional label mode (`"%"`, `"none"` or a unit) follow.

goto.name: goto
goto.description:
Navigates to the specified passage.

Usage: `{goto "passage"}`

parameterDocs.name: passage
parameterDocs.documentation: Passage to navigate to.

back.name: back
back.description:
Creates a link or navigates to the previous passage in history.

Usage: `{back}`

forward.name: forward
forward.description:
Creates a link or navigates to the next passage in history.

Usage: `{forward}`

include.name: include
include.description:
Outputs the contents of the specified passage. The argument is a passage name or an expression that evaluates to one; add `inline` to render the passage as inline content without markdown processing.

Usage: `{include "passage"}`, `{include $passageName}` or `{include "passage" inline}`

parameterDocs.name: passage
parameterDocs.documentation: Passage name or an expression that evaluates to one; `inline` may follow.

passage.name: passage
passage.description:
Outputs the name of the current passage.

Usage: `{passage}`

textbox.name: textbox
textbox.description:
Creates a text input box bound to a story variable.

Usage: `{textbox $receiver}` or `{textbox $receiver "placeholder"}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) the box is bound to.

parameterDocs.name: placeholder
parameterDocs.documentation: Placeholder text.

numberbox.name: numberbox
numberbox.description:
Creates a number input box bound to a story variable.

Usage: `{numberbox $receiver}` or `{numberbox $receiver "placeholder"}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) the box is bound to.

parameterDocs.name: placeholder
parameterDocs.documentation: Placeholder text.

textarea.name: textarea
textarea.description:
Creates a multi-line text input area bound to a story variable.

Usage: `{textarea $receiver}` or `{textarea $receiver "placeholder"}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) the area is bound to.

parameterDocs.name: placeholder
parameterDocs.documentation: Placeholder text.

checkbox.name: checkbox
checkbox.description:
Creates a checkbox that toggles a boolean story variable.

Usage: `{checkbox $receiver "label"}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Boolean story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) the checkbox toggles.

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Label shown next to the checkbox.

radiobutton.name: radiobutton
radiobutton.description:
Creates a radio button that sets a story variable to its value. Use the same variable for every option in a group.

Usage: `{radiobutton $receiver "value" "label"}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Story variable (`$name` or `"$name"`) shared by the radio group.

parameterDocs.name: value
parameterDocs.documentation: Value stored when this radio button is chosen.

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Label shown next to the radio button; defaults to the value.

quicksave.name: quicksave
quicksave.description:
Performs a quick save of the current story state.

Usage: `{quicksave}`

quickload.name: quickload
quickload.description:
Loads the most recent quick save.

Usage: `{quickload}`

dialog.name: dialog

parameterDocs.name: label
parameterDocs.documentation: Text of the button that opens the dialog.

parameterDocs.name: noclose
parameterDocs.documentation: Literal `noclose` hides the dialog close button.

nobr.name: nobr
nobr.description:
Removes line breaks from its contents.

Usage:

```
{nobr}
  ...
{/nobr}
```

span.name: span
span.description:
Wraps its contents in a `<span>` element.

Usage:

```
{span}
  ...
{/span}
```

settings-controls.name: settings-controls
settings-controls.description:
Renders the settings controls UI.

Usage: `{settings-controls}`

watch.name: watch
watch.description:
Watches a variable for changes and triggers a re-render.

Usage: `{watch $var}`

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Variable to watch for changes.

parameterDocs.name: variable
parameterDocs.documentation: Variable to stop watching.

unless.name: unless
unless.description:
Conditionally displays its contents when the expression is falsy. The inverse of `{if}`.

Usage:

```
{unless condition}
  ...
{/unless}
```

parameterDocs.name: condition
parameterDocs.documentation: Expression; the contents show when it is falsy.
